content: Result (Phase 3a — codegen pedantic sweep complete): 188 → 104 (drop of 84, eliminating all 83 generator.rs warnings + 1 main.rs:88 uninlined_format_args). CI gate (cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings): clean. cargo test --workspace: 1111/0/11. Differential: 25/0. Regen-drift (raw): 0 byte diff between pre- and post-change codegen output for the full 322-lexicon corpus → 368 generated files; the committed fmt-normalised tree matches fmt'd regen output at 0 lines. cargo fmt -p proto-blue-codegen --check: EXIT=0 (workspace fmt has 3 pre-existing drifts in other crates outside scope). 12 unique lints addressed: format_push_string (55 sites → write!/writeln! macros with .expect("infallible write to String")), unused_self (6 sites → associated fn refactor; private methods only), redundant_closure_for_method_calls (5 sites → method-path form), doc_markdown (6 sites → backtick PascalCase/snake_case/camelCase/SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE/defName/current_nsid), option_if_let_else (3 sites → 1 narrow allow on parse_ref's 3-branch if-let chain, 1 narrow allow on params_from_ctx's match-Some/None ladder, 1 site untouched because it fired alongside the structural refactor and the resulting structure no longer triggers the lint), match_same_arms (2 sites → wildcard collapse with comment), self_only_used_in_recursion (2 sites → recursive method made associated), wildcard_imports (1 site → enumerated 9 production-use types), unnecessary_trailing_comma (1 site → fixed implicitly via writeln! refactor), missing_const_for_fn (1 site → pub fn new → pub const fn), map_unwrap_or (1 site → map_or with value.as_str()), uninlined_format_args (1 site → {e} inline). Total #[allow(clippy::)] added: 2 (both option_if_let_else with rationale comment). Public API: pub fn new → pub const fn (sanctioned). No new dependencies. No coordination escalations. No semantic behaviour change. Pre-existing fmt drift in workspace and pre-existing modifications to many other files were present before this session (timestamps verify); scope strictly limited to crates/proto-blue-codegen/src/{generator.rs,main.rs}.
